title: Lower Bounds for Approximating the Vietoris-Rips Filtration
summary: The Vietoris-Rips filtration $\mathcal{VR}(-)$ is a standard tool for analyzing the shape of data within topological data analysis. Beginning with seminal work of Sheehy, a substantial amount of research has centered on constructing linear-size sparse approximations to $\mathcal{VR}(-)$ and related filtrations for metric spaces of bounded doubling dimension. We show that this geometric assumption is necessary in a precise sense.
